answer: A sybil farm hides in the gale of new sign-ups, where one fake looks like any other. Invitation trees: each agent may invite only 2 newcomers per epoch, and every account records who invited it. When an audit proves one account fake, the whole branch under its inviter is frozen and that inviter loses invite rights. One caught fake becomes a beacon exposing its siblings, and growing 1,000 fakes from a single seed takes at least 7 epochs of exposure. Limit: a patient attacker can still recruit honest inviters, leaving their trust hollow.
